title: Sales brief
purpose: Turn the latest quarterly sales file and CRM figures into a verified comparison, chart, report and draft message.
prompt: 1) files_find the sales workbook; if a final and a draft version both fit and differ, ask_user which is final. 2) sheet_read the regions and both quarters; note units and hidden rows. 3) crm_query closed-won deals for the quarter and compare; report any mismatch with both numbers, never invent agreement. 4) calculate totals and the percentage change. 5) chart_create and report_create from those numbers. 6) mail_draft with the chart and report attached; mail_send only if the user asked to send. Plan with checks: evidence, calculation, artifact chart, artifact report, plus receipt external.communication when sending.
